title: Worker state answer
description: The hub's 200 answer to POST /api/station/stt/state (WorkerApi.handle, sizeup/cloud/sttworkers.py). The worker client reads `pool_on` (and `worker_update`, for its self-update, and `config`, its settings from the hub) and ignores the rest.

pool_on.description: The pool is on and has a worker in it.

worker_update.title: Worker update
worker_update.description: Only to a GPU worker that sent `self_update`: the version the hub wants it on (sizeup/cloud/sttworkers.py WorkerApi.wanted). The worker takes it only from main of actualsecurity/sizeup on GitHub, with exactly this hash, and never uses `url`.

mode.description: `auto`: the hub's own build; `pin`: a version an admin chose; `hold`: none (no commit or hash). A worker takes a word it does not know as `hold`.

commit.description: A commit on main. Absent with `hold`, and with `auto` while the hub can't tell its build (a local run).

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of deploy/stt-worker/worker.py at that commit.

url.description: For people: raw.githubusercontent.com's address of that file. The worker builds its own.

config.title: Settings from the hub
config.description: Only to a GPU worker that sent `config`, and only while its `applied_rev` isn't `rev`: the hub's desired config for it (sizeup/cloud/workerconfig.py; an admin's, audited). The worker checks every value by the same rules and takes only these keys (worker.toml keeps the bootstrap: hub_url, the tokens, the paths). A key it doesn't know is reported `unknown` and left alone.

rev.description: A hash of `values` (sorted keys, no spaces; SHA-256, 16 hex digits).

values.description: The keys an admin set; a key left out is the worker's own (worker.toml, else its default).

gate_dbfs.description: Applied with no clip or LLM call in hand.

llm_priority.description: Applied with no clip or LLM call in hand.

managed_models.description: Applied with no clip or LLM call in hand.

vram_budget_mb.description: Applied with no clip or LLM call in hand. At most the GPU's memory as the worker said it.

vram_reserve_mb.description: Applied with no clip or LLM call in hand. At most the GPU's memory as the worker said it.

llm_vram_mb.description: Applied with no clip or LLM call in hand. At most the GPU's memory as the worker said it.

primary_vram_mb.description: Applied with no clip or LLM call in hand. At most the GPU's memory as the worker said it.

whisper_flags.description: Its options after the program, less the ones the worker owns (-m, --model, --host, --port): only WHISPER_ARGS's. Restarts the whisper-server the worker runs, while idle, then its self-test.

llm_flags.description: Its options after the program, less the ones the worker owns (-m, --model, --host, --port): only LLM_ARGS's. Restarts the llama-server the worker runs, while idle, then its self-test.
